text:
marie: Found a bunch of 404s in docs/runtime/kv-cache during the smoke run. Quick list:
- /docs/runtime/kv-cache#prefix-caching
- /docs/runtime/examples/cache-cli -> both 404. Can owners claim? Need patch before next deploy.

jonathan: Thanks @marie — do you have the exact file paths? I can run a grep quickly.

marie: grep output below:
```
$ rg "404" docs/runtime -n || true
docs/runtime/kv-cache.md:142:![diagram](../assets/kv-cache-diagram.png)
docs/runtime/examples/cache-cli.md:12:[Link to API](/api/runtime/cache)
```

docs-bot: deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded for main @ 2026-03-18T09:12Z :white_check_mark: (posting FYI)

lia-docs: @marie I'll take ownership of kv-cache.md. I'll open a tiny PR to rehost the diagram and fix the link. ETA ~30m.

kevin: For cache-cli.md can we just redirect /api/runtime/cache -> /api/runtime/cache-v1? If so I'll add a rewrite rule. cc @lia-docs for PR review.

tara: If it's a config change (redirect), ops might prefer it in the infra repo ticket. Should we do both: redirect + content fix?

lia-docs: I'll do content fix + update links. @kevin if you can add the redirect, please file the infra PR and tag me for review. I'll reference both in the docs PR.

marie: Quick note: the example snippet in cache-cli.md uses endpoint /v0/generate, looks outdated — please update to /v1/generate while you're in there. small API tidy.

jonathan: Re reviewer, can we get @eng-oncall to eyeball the redirect? I don't think it's risky but want a quick nod.

kevin: Filed infra PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/412 (rewrite rule). Linking here for trace. I'll ping eng-oncall.

lia-docs: Opened docs PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/198 — fixes image, updates links, updates snippet to /v1/generate. Requesting @kevin and @tara review.

tara: Looking now. If nothing else, let's merge post-approval. Good catch @marie.

docs-bot: note: docs PR lint passed; 1 failing image-check until image rehosted. :mag_right:

marie: :thumbsup: I'll mark this as resolved in the sprint board. Thanks all.
